_comment: AUTOMATION TARGET. Every entry here is an ILLUSTRATIVE DEAL STRUCTURE, not a completed transaction. The renderer stamps that disclaimer on every card automatically — do not remove it. IMPORTANT: the indicative values below are structural placeholders, NOT sourced market prices. Set price_status to 'sourced' and populate price_source/price_as_of only once a real quote or exchange reference is attached. While price_status is 'placeholder' the site shows an amber warning banner above the grid.
disclaimer: Illustrative example based on live market conditions — an executable deal structure, not a completed transaction.

deals.title: Unrefined shea butter — Nigeria to European cosmetics manufacturer
deals.summary: Northern Nigeria produces shea at scale but most volume leaves through intermediaries. A structure that reaches cooperative-level supply improves both traceability and margin.

specs.label: Commodity
specs.value: Grade A unrefined shea butter

specs.label: Supply side
specs.value: Cooperative aggregators, Niger & Kwara States

specs.label: Buyer profile
specs.value: EU natural-cosmetics manufacturer

specs.label: Indicative volume
specs.value: 2 × 20ft containers / quarter

specs.label: Bee Moore role
specs.value: Supplier identification, capability verification, sample coordination, export documentation, shipment oversight

specs.label: Fee basis
specs.value: Success fee on shipped value, or fixed sourcing retainer

deals.title: Sesame seed — Nigeria to Gulf commodity importer
deals.summary: Sesame is one of Nigeria's most consistent non-oil exports. The recurring failure point is not supply — it is quality consistency across lots and counterparty reliability at scale.

specs.label: Commodity
specs.value: Whitish sesame seed, 98/2 spec

specs.label: Supply side
specs.value: Aggregators, Benue & Jigawa States

specs.label: Buyer profile
specs.value: Gulf-region importer / re-exporter

specs.label: Indicative volume
specs.value: 500 MT, staged across contracts

specs.label: Bee Moore role
specs.value: Aggregator verification, pre-shipment quality protocol, SGS coordination, documentation

specs.label: Fee basis
specs.value: Success fee on executed volume

deals.title: Raw cashew nut — Nigeria to Asian processor
deals.summary: Season timing governs everything in cashew. Buyers who commit before verifying warehouse position and outturn quality carry most of the risk in the chain.

specs.label: Commodity
specs.value: Raw cashew nut, outturn-graded

specs.label: Supply side
specs.value: Kogi, Oyo and Enugu warehousing

specs.label: Buyer profile
specs.value: Asian shelling and processing operation

specs.label: Indicative volume
specs.value: Container-load contracts, seasonal

specs.label: Bee Moore role
specs.value: Warehouse inspection, outturn verification, seller diligence, loading supervision

specs.label: Fee basis
specs.value: Success fee, or per-inspection fixed fee

deals.title: Consumer goods manufacturer — export-first Nigeria entry
deals.summary: The reflex is to incorporate immediately. With a ₦100m share-capital floor for any company with foreign participation, that is usually the expensive path before volume justifies it.

specs.label: Client profile
specs.value: Mid-sized international consumer-goods producer

specs.label: Question
specs.value: Export through a distributor, or incorporate and operate locally?

specs.label: Sequence
specs.value: Regulator identification → NAFDAC pathway → distributor shortlist → export trial → incorporation at proven volume

specs.label: Capital note
specs.value: ₦100m minimum share capital applies from the first day of any foreign shareholding

specs.label: Bee Moore role
specs.value: Entry-route modelling, regulator mapping, distributor search and verification, launch support

specs.label: Indicative timeline
specs.value: 60–90 days to first commercial shipment

deals.title: Agro-processing facility — greenfield FDI with local partner
deals.summary: Nigeria exports raw and imports processed. Processing capacity sited near the growing region captures the spread — provided the power and offtake assumptions are tested rather than assumed.

specs.label: Sector
specs.value: Agro-processing / value addition

specs.label: Location
specs.value: Southwest or North-Central, sited to feedstock

specs.label: Structure
specs.value: 100% foreign ownership permitted; local operating partner optional but usually decisive

specs.label: Regulatory
specs.value: CAC incorporation → NIPC registration → business permit → NAFDAC where applicable

specs.label: Incentive note
specs.value: Pioneer status ended in 2025. Model the performance-based EDTI (5% annual credit on qualifying capex for five years) instead

specs.label: Bee Moore role
specs.value: Feasibility intelligence, site and feedstock verification, partner search, regulatory sequencing, government liaison

deals.title: Free-zone logistics and light assembly operation
deals.summary: NEPZA free zones offer a materially different tax and customs position for export-oriented operations — but only if the business model genuinely fits the zone's terms.

specs.label: Sector
specs.value: Logistics, warehousing, light assembly

specs.label: Structure
specs.value: NEPZA free-zone enterprise

specs.label: Indicative minimum
specs.value: US $500,000 investment (indicative NEPZA threshold)

specs.label: Trade-off
specs.value: Tax and customs advantages against restrictions on selling into the domestic customs territory

specs.label: Bee Moore role
specs.value: Zone comparison, eligibility assessment, NEPZA liaison, operator introductions

specs.label: Honest caveat
specs.value: Free-zone status suits export-led models. If the plan is to sell domestically, it is usually the wrong structure

deals.title: Lagos waterways passenger transport — equipment supply and operating partnership
deals.summary: Lagos is a lagoon city with chronic road congestion and an under-built water-transport network. State policy has favoured expansion; the commercial gap is vessels, jetty infrastructure and operator capability.

specs.label: Sector
specs.value: Marine passenger transport, jetty and waterfront infrastructure

specs.label: Opportunity
specs.value: Vessel supply, safety systems, terminal development, operator partnership

specs.label: Counterparties
specs.value: Private operators and state waterway authorities

specs.label: Key diligence
specs.value: Route licensing, vessel certification, safety compliance, realistic ridership

specs.label: Bee Moore role
specs.value: Sector intelligence, operator identification and verification, stakeholder mapping, partnership structuring

specs.label: Honest caveat
specs.value: Advisory and commercial facilitation. Bee Moore is not a marine engineering or vessel-operating company

deals.title: Waterfront leisure and hospitality development — Lagos East corridor
deals.summary: The Epe and Lekki corridor is where Lagos physically expands. Land and waterfront positions there price differently from the island, and the leisure market is materially under-served.

specs.label: Sector
specs.value: Hospitality, leisure, destination development

specs.label: Location
specs.value: Lagos East / Epe Division corridor

specs.label: Opportunity
specs.value: Waterfront leisure assets, tour product development, hospitality partnership

specs.label: Critical diligence
specs.value: Land title chain, Certificate of Occupancy, community consent, access infrastructure

specs.label: Bee Moore role
specs.value: Corridor intelligence, title-chain verification support, local partner identification, community and state stakeholder navigation

specs.label: Honest caveat
specs.value: Land title is the single largest risk in Nigerian real estate. Verify before any payment, without exception

deals.title: Public-sector supply and infrastructure — opportunity intelligence
deals.summary: Federal and state procurement is a genuine market that foreign firms routinely misread — usually by underestimating registration requirements and payment timelines.

specs.label: Scope
specs.value: Tender and opportunity intelligence, eligibility assessment, local partnering

specs.label: Typical route
specs.value: BPP registration, local entity or JV partner, prequalification, bid support

specs.label: Bee Moore role
specs.value: Opportunity monitoring, eligibility mapping, local partner identification, lawful stakeholder engagement

specs.label: Payment reality
specs.value: Public-sector payment cycles can be long. Model working capital accordingly

specs.label: Hard limit
specs.value: Bee Moore does not offer, imply or facilitate influence over contract awards, and does not represent any government body

deals.title: Entertainment and creative industry — market access partnership
deals.summary: Nigerian music, film and creator output travels globally; the commercial infrastructure around it is uneven. Foreign entrants need rights clarity before capital, not after.

specs.label: Sector
specs.value: Music, film, events, creator economy

specs.label: Opportunity
specs.value: Distribution partnership, sponsorship, production JV, market access

specs.label: Key diligence
specs.value: Rights ownership and chain of title, existing contractual encumbrances, revenue verification

specs.label: Bee Moore role
specs.value: Sector intelligence, counterparty verification, introductions, commercial structuring, communications

specs.label: Honest caveat
specs.value: Advisory capability and active area of interest. Not a claim of completed transactions in this sector

deals.title: Established Nigerian SME — acquisition or majority stake
deals.summary: Buying an operating business avoids the cold-start problem, but Nigerian SME financials are frequently informal. Verified cash generation, not the stated P&L, is what you are actually buying.

specs.label: Target profile
specs.value: Owner-managed operating business with genuine market position

specs.label: Sectors
specs.value: Distribution, light manufacturing, logistics, services

specs.label: Critical diligence
specs.value: Bank-statement reconciliation against stated revenue, CAC filings, tax position, asset title, undisclosed liabilities, key-person dependency

specs.label: Bee Moore role
specs.value: Target identification, approach, commercial and reputational diligence, negotiation support

specs.label: Honest caveat
specs.value: Legal and financial due diligence is performed by qualified professionals. Bee Moore coordinates and provides commercial and reputational intelligence
